lede: UCLA carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.9 against -2.6, a 13.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Minnesota +11.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with UCLA winning 77% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is run offense, where UCLA leads Minnesota by 121 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
